messages:
Marta V: Looping folks — Ballast sent over a draft for their billing API connector. We need to verify how their events map to our SKU model before we spin up the ingestion job. Posting what they gave below and a few questions.

James H: Nice, curious — do they distinguish embeddings vs text generation events at the payload level?

Marta V: Their example webhook they provided:```{
  "customer_id": "rw_123",
  "event": "tokens.generated",
  "model": "gpt-large",
  "tokens": 1234,
  "type": "generation"
}```

Elaine P: That helps but we need explicit embedding event types and per-embedding vector counts (not just tokens). Ask them to include a usage_type field (embedding|generation|rerank) and a numeric item_count for embeddings.

Marta V: They also uploaded a CSV sample to S3: https://s3.aws/ballast/samples/usage_export_2026-03.csv — header they showed: customer_id,ts_start,ts_end,sku_id,quantity,unit_price,currency,usage_type

James H: Good. Follow-ups from my side: (1) what is sku_id mapping granularity (model vs capability vs embedding), (2) do they provide idempotency keys for events to avoid double-billing, (3) backfill/retry policy if an event is missed?

Ballast-bot: Ballast: We can include usage_type="embedding" or "generation". Each event will include an idempotency_key. Rate limit for webhooks is 1000 req/min. We retry failed deliveries for 24h with exponential backoff and provide a daily backfill CSV for any missed events. Sample payload (staging):```{
  "customer_id": "rw_123",
  "event": "usage.recorded",
  "usage_type": "embedding",
  "item_count": 42,
  "tokens": 0,
  "idempotency_key": "evt_20260323_abc123"
}```

Marta V: Important — Finance wants invoice CSV delivered within 48h after month end. Also need timezone normalization (UTC) and a clear column for our PO number. Can we get their SLA for invoice delivery and credits for late invoices?

Elaine P: Negotiation points: trial credits and overage thresholds. Propose a pilot commit with a soft cap and a 10% discount for the first year. Also request net-30 payment terms and a 30-day dispute window for billing errors. Need vendor's process for issuing refunds/credits.

James H: I'll draft an email with the technical asks + the billing/contract items. @procure-bot any guidance on the approval path for a pilot PO?

procure-bot: Procure-bot: For pilot spend under $50k we can proceed with a simplified PO. Approval required from Finance lead @Arjun K. Standard net-30 is acceptable; SLA credits and custom dispute language are negotiable during contract review.

Marta V: Tagging @Arjun K — can you greenlight pilot PO and confirm Finance will accept their test webhook to our staging? Also need confirmation on PII handling in their daily CSV exports.

Arjun K: Approved to proceed with pilot. Finance will accept a staged webhook on our test endpoint and needs a sample invoice + sample CSV before PO issued. I'll have legal flag the data handling clauses — no raw PII in exports, tokenized IDs only.

Marta V: Great. Next action: James to compile 3 ingestion mapping rules to send to Ballast. I'll include the billing and contract asks in the same thread.

James H: Draft mapping rules: 1) Map usage_type -> sku_id (embedding -> SKU-EMB, generation -> SKU-GEN). 2) Require idempotency_key; reject/flag events lacking it. 3) Convert all timestamps to UTC and bucket by billing_period_start (month). Will attach examples in the email.

Marta V: Awesome, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
